Azerbaijan
Consular help: Consular help will be provided by the Consulate General of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Istanbul, Türkiye.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport NO up to 30 days
Service/Official biometric passport NO up to 30 days
Diplomatic biometric passport NO up to 30 days
NOTE: The visa-free regime for citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina is valid from 1 August 2026 to 1 August 2027. Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina may enter the territory of the Republic of Azerbaijan up to three times during the specified period without a visa, with a maximum stay of 30 days per entry.
Contact address: Džemala Bijedića 305, 71210 IlidžaTel: 00387 33 695 802Fax: 00387 33 695 801
Citizens of Azerbaijan, holders of ordinary passports are exempted from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit, transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days for a period of six months, starting from the day of entry.
Citizens of Azerbaijan, the holders of diplomatic and service passports, shall be exempt from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit, transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 30 days.
Visa shall be issued in Istanbul, Türkiye.
